name: liveness_status
description: Forge-observed repository availability, distinct from recency of activity.

definitions.active: The forge reports an available repository.
definitions.archived: The repository is available but archived.
definitions.moved: The repository resolves to a different canonical URL.
definitions.missing: The forge positively reports the repository missing.
definitions.disabled: The forge reports the repository disabled.
definitions.unknown: The attempt did not establish repository availability.

standard.none: Project-defined observation vocabulary; no external standard applies.
